metrics.selection_metric: Maximum validation average precision; log loss breaks ties
metrics.label_definition: No completed order in the next 90 calendar days
metrics.eligible_population: At least 90 days tenure and a completed purchase in the preceding 180 days

split_policy.description: Chronological customer panels; customers can recur across snapshots. No future outcome crosses a split boundary.

risk_thresholds.selection: High maximizes validation F2; Medium starts at half the High threshold

production_refit.note: Production refit uses all matured labels; test metrics describe the separate frozen evaluation model

metrics.revenue_definition: Prior 180-day completed revenue / 2 × churn probability; exposure proxy, not causal revenue loss
metrics.importance_definition: Validation permutation decrease in average precision; 3 repeats, up to 4000 rows

forecast_metrics.selection_metric: Pooled rolling-origin MAE over observed horizons 1 to 6

rolling_origin_cv.note: Expanding history; future actuals are unavailable to each fit. Recent origins contribute only observed horizons. Model selection and reported errors share these folds; there is no independent forecast test set.

intervals.method: Per-horizon rolling residual 10th/90th percentiles, widened to contain point forecast and clipped at zero
intervals.limitation: Approximate empirical ranges from limited, overlapping folds used for model selection; no guaranteed coverage or formal confidence level. Do not sum bounds into a total-revenue interval.
